posts.title: Cascade Crest 100M 2026 - Race Report
posts.description: On Friday, July 17, I finished the Cascade Crest 100 in 33:08:47 . That put me 102nd out of 130 finishers. More importantly, it was my second finish at Cascade Crest and earned me my second buckle. It has been a couple of weeks, and I still get emotional thinking about the finish. I am incredibly proud of this one.

posts.title: I Used Opus 4.6 to Audit and Optimize My UniFi Network (And You Can Too)
